description: Tutorial lesson T2 (Musterin' da Boyz), mouse+keyboard player path: fresh tutorial game booted from the lesson's config (no fixture) -> Formations panel: attach Warboss to Boyz via the dropdown, tick Boyz into the Battlewagon, Confirm Formations (batch declares incl. DECLARE_TRANSPORT_EMBARKATION) -> deployment roll-off via the dialog Roll/Continue buttons -> the 'rotate_wagon' step: pick the Battlewagon up, prove the step does NOT advance on selection alone and that Confirm is gated shut, turn the ghost a quarter turn with six real 'E' presses, and watch the step advance on the turn -> deploy the Battlewagon: place it, nudge it (shift+click back up, drop it elsewhere, asserting Confirm is gated until that is done), Confirm (click board + Confirm) with the AI alternating, asserting the taught rotation actually lands on the deployed model -> deploy Gretchin with the Tight formation -> first-turn roll-off -> lesson complete. The Formations panel and roll-off dialog are embedded modal Windows: their buttons are driven via the emit escape hatch and the tie-tolerant roll steps emit only if the button is still present.

steps.comment: OptionButton popup menus are native Windows - select+emit is the dropdown escape hatch
the Formations panel is a modal embedded Window - synthetic root-viewport clicks cannot reach its controls; setting button_pressed emits toggled exactly like a click
tie tolerance: press the roll button if still up, else the A DEAD HEAT re-roll button; no-op when neither exists
park the pointer where the wagon will go so the ghost renders on the board - the rotation has to be VISIBLE in the screenshots below, not just readable off the controller

steps.script:
var dc = tree.root.get_node("Main").deployment_controller
if dc.ghost_sprite == null:
	return "NO_GHOST"
return abs(wrapf(dc.ghost_sprite.get_base_rotation() - BoardState.get_default_facing_for_player(1), -PI, PI)) < 0.001
steps.comment: the wagon ghost starts at the default enemy-facing, so the rotate step cannot be already-done on entry
picking the wagon up is NOT enough - the step still waits for a real turn
Confirm is gated until the wagon is turned - otherwise a player could deploy it flat and strand the step with no ghost left to rotate
rotate_right = +15 degrees a tap, so six taps is a quarter turn

steps.script:
var dc = tree.root.get_node("Main").deployment_controller
var want = BoardState.get_default_facing_for_player(1) + PI / 2.0
return abs(wrapf(dc.ghost_sprite.get_base_rotation() - want, -PI, PI)) < 0.02

steps.comment: turning the ghost is what advances the step
placing the wagon now advances to the nudge step, not straight to Confirm
shift+click the placed wagon to pick it back up - the gesture this step teaches
drop 1.5in sideways: the wagon was turned 90deg so its long axis is horizontal, and the zone's y<=12in step sits just below

steps.script:
var m = GameState.get_unit("U_BATTLEWAGON_T").models[0]
var want = BoardState.get_default_facing_for_player(1) + PI / 2.0
return abs(wrapf(float(m.get("rotation", 0.0)) - want, -PI, PI)) < 0.02
steps.comment: the turn the tutorial taught actually lands on the deployed wagon, not just on the ghost
Tight lays one rank of 5 per click - second rank
tie tolerance: press the roll button if still up, else the A DEAD HEAT re-roll button; no-op when neither exists
